THE BUILD

The thinking behind the page.

A useful project has to connect its interface to the visitor’s task.

Audience

People who need a clear path into College Management System and an interface they can understand quickly.

Experience

Grouping different academic tasks into clear sections.

Next iteration

Review real visitor feedback and refine the areas where people hesitate or need more context.

Interface decisions

Academic administration spans people with different jobs. Student information, attendance, fees and notices should be grouped by task.

What I would keep refining

Permission and data handling become important in a real deployment. This project is presented as an interface concept; production use would need careful requirements and access design.
